english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the body part, and in compounds such as 頁頭 it can mean the front or beginning of something.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tau4 zung6 tung3 gan2

english.note: Use 頭 as the everyday all-purpose noun for the person in charge of a group.

examples.english: The chief of this group is highly respected.
examples.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 jan4 go3 tau4 hou2 jau5 wai1 mong6
